svg.aria-label: One request runs auth, role, tenant and checkFeature before the controller, and every query filters by req.clinicId. The public share route is the only exception. Below, the eleven features and the role and plan each one needs.
svg.text: One chain, then eleven features on top
Every route runs steps 1 to 4 before your controller. Red boxes are the rejections you must test in Postman.
THE CHAIN · built in Phase 1, used by all twenty route files
THE ONE EXCEPTION · the public share route (F5)
no auth · no tenant · no audit
WHAT SITS ON TOP · the eleven features and the gate each one needs
rules per diagnosis tag, gone-cold list
ETA from the last 20 real consults
high severity blocked without a reason
five models merged into one sorted array
who opened which record, when, from where
;htn expands, a whole Rx in one call
F1 to F4 in one Promise.all response
mocked payment, expiry falls back to Free
helmet, rate limits, no leaked fields
Phase 1 builds the chain. Phases 2 to 4 build the cards. Nothing in the bottom half is safe if the top half is wrong.
